def _percent(value: Decimal) -> str:
    return f"{value * Decimal(100):.2f}%"


def _ratio(value: Decimal | None) -> str:
    return "unavailable" if value is None else f"{value:.2f}x"


def render_sector_radar_daily_summary(
    result: SectorRadarDailyResult,
) -> str:
    _validate_result(result)
    composition = result.composition
    lines = [
        f"## Sector Discovery Radar — {result.market_session.isoformat()}",
        "",
        "**SHADOW OBSERVATION ONLY**",
        "",
        "`NOT RESEARCH` · `NOT A RECOMMENDATION`",
        "",
        "`HUMAN ATTENTION AUTHORITY = NONE` · `INVESTMENT AUTHORITY = NONE`",
        "",
        (
            f"New false→true entries: **{len(composition.all_candidates)}** · "
            f"shadow groups shown: **{len(composition.surfaced_groups)}**"
        ),
        "",
    ]
    if not composition.surfaced_groups:
        lines.extend(
            [
                "Nothing new qualified for the separate Sector Radar shadow surface.",
                "",
            ]
        )
    for index, group in enumerate(composition.surfaced_groups, start=1):
        candidate = group.primary_candidate
        breadth = group.primary_breadth
        lines.extend(
            [
                f"### {index}. {candidate.name} `{candidate.thscode}`",
                "",
                f"- What changed: `{candidate.event_type}`.",
                (
                    "- Relative path: "
                    f"5-session rating {candidate.horizon_5_rating} "
                    f"(rank {candidate.horizon_5_rank}); "
                    f"20-session rating {candidate.horizon_20_rating} "
                    f"(rank {candidate.horizon_20_rank}); "
                    f"60-session rating {candidate.horizon_60_rating}."
                ),
                (
                    "- Trend age: "
                    f"{candidate.positive_20d_excess_persistence_sessions} "
                    "sessions of positive 20-session excess; "
                    f"{candidate.top_quartile_20d_persistence_sessions} "
                    "sessions in the 20-session top quartile."
                ),
                (
                    "- Acceleration and turnover: "
                    f"20-session rank change "
                    f"{candidate.rank_change_5_sessions_20d}; "
                    f"excess acceleration "
                    f"{_percent(candidate.excess_acceleration_5_sessions_20d)}; "
                    f"turnover pulse "
                    f"{_ratio(candidate.turnover_pulse_5_vs_prior_20)}."
                ),
                (
                    "- Current breadth: "
                    f"{breadth.advancers}/{breadth.priced_member_count} priced "
                    f"members advanced; {breadth.priced_member_count}/"
                    f"{breadth.member_count} members priced "
                    f"({_percent(breadth.coverage_ratio)} coverage); "
                    f"median return {_percent(breadth.equal_weight_median_daily_return)}."
                ),
                (
                    "- Current concentration: top-three turnover share "
                    f"{'unavailable' if breadth.top_three_turnover_share is None else _percent(breadth.top_three_turnover_share)}; "
                    "top-three positive-return mass share "
                    f"{'unavailable' if breadth.top_three_positive_return_mass_share is None else _percent(breadth.top_three_positive_return_mass_share)}."
                ),
                f"- Grouping: `{group.grouping_reason}`.",
            ]
        )
        if group.parent_context_thscode is not None:
            lines.append(
                "- Current parent context: "
                f"{group.parent_context_name} "
                f"`{group.parent_context_thscode}`."
            )
        if group.granular_drivers:
            lines.append(
                "- Granular drivers: "
                + ", ".join(
                    f"{item.name} `{item.thscode}`"
                    for item in group.granular_drivers
                )
                + "."
            )
        lines.append("")

    if composition.omitted_groups:
        lines.extend(
            [
                (
                    f"{len(composition.omitted_groups)} additional complete group(s) "
                    "were omitted only from the 0–3 Human projection and remain in "
                    "the full audit artifact."
                ),
                "",
            ]
        )
    lines.extend(
        [
            f"Market-state hash: `{result.output_market_state_hash}`",
            "",
            f"Event-ledger hash: `{result.event_ledger_hash}`",
            "",
            f"Full result hash: `{result.result_hash}`",
            "",
            "Sector price strength and current breadth are discovery facts only. "
            "They do not establish company economics, valuation, Odds, a "
            "Recommendation, or an Action.",
            "",
        ]
    )
    return "\n".join(lines)
